title: SpecSync config comment still names writer and CI 6.1.0
symptom: The header comment in .specsync/config.toml says writer/CI 6.1.0 while lifecycle writers and CI use SpecSync 6.1.1
expected: The comment names the version actually used, or no version
impact: Misleading comment only; no behavior or gate depends on it. Fixing it needs a native change that covers .specsync/config.toml, which the approved scope does not.

notes.text: Fixed in plan step 12 (PR #238, t38b): the SpecSync config comment names 6.2.0, HI 0.8.0 and Fledge 1.8.0 and joins the version check. Passed here; the red run on 0.5.0 is to be recorded before verification.
Red on 0.5.0 (red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-batch-red 370d221d): the SpecSync config comment names only SpecSync's pin, not HI's and Fledge's, so the pin check cannot read it.
